ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Oxherding verses are an ordered Chan verse-sequence that stages seeking, finding, handling, losing, and moving beyond the ox. The label is not admitted from contents headings alone: complete sequences follow it in masters’ records, other masters write named harmonizations, and Yuetong publicly tests a request for such verses by saying that one must use one’s own.
EvidenceBody: Jiguang Huo’s record prints the label directly before a staged sequence beginning with entering the hills to seek the ox and continuing through finding tracks, catching, tending, forgetting ox and person, returning to the source, and entering the marketplace.

Shiyu Mingfang, Xiangtian Jinian Jingxian, and Fushi Tongxian each supply actual harmonized sequences rather than bare catalogue labels; their opening stage names and first lines are preserved beside the exact headword.
The Brocade River lamp biography quotes an oxherding verse after saying its subject harmonized an earlier sequence.

When Sanmu asks Yuetong for oxherding verses, Yuetong answers that one must use one’s own and then tests Sanmu’s attempted whisk gesture. The genre is therefore deployed inside an interview as well as transmitted in verse sections.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The livestock action becomes an ordered verse-map and an object of public testing: masters write, harmonize, request, and challenge oxherding verses as a recognizable Chan genre.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: A contents-page occurrence alone proves only that a label was printed. This entry relies on witnesses where the sequence, its stages, its verses, or its public request are visible in the same full unit.

ComparedThings: a master’s harmonization of that sequence
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Original sequences, harmonizations, and a request for the verses all concern the same named genre. Different authors and stage wording do not create different kinds of object.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Oxherding, ox, verses, sequence, ten, Puming, harmonized, and seeking reflect the attested title, its common ten-stage shape, and the corpus’s explicit 和 forms.

ModifierControls.reason: 牧牛 modifies 頌 as verses about herding the ox. 牧牛圖 includes the pictorial sequence and 牧牛 alone is the action; neither is silently counted as the exact verse label.

FamilyControls.reason: 牧牛圖頌 is the expanded pictures-and-verses title; 和牧牛頌 and 和普明禪師牧牛頌 name harmonizations. They confirm the genre but remain searchable family forms.
